title: Exactly one bounded verifier witness is an NP-language difference
claims: AtLeastTwoWitnessesInNP constructs a measured verifier for two distinct bounded witnesses.
UniqueWitnessAsNPDifference represents the exactly-one-witness predicate as the difference of two pinned NP languages.
P_subset_NP is independently checked against the pinned definitions.
